# Equativ
> Global end-to-end media platform for advertisers, publishers, and retailers, combining ad tech, data intelligence, and AI-driven activation.

Equativ provides omnichannel advertising and monetization solutions across curation, CTV, retail media, creative formats, sustainability, and publisher revenue optimization. The platform also includes specialized offerings such as Serverside.AI, Sharethrough, and Kamino Retail.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://smartadserver.com/): Overview of Equativ’s end-to-end media platform and core product positioning.
- [For Advertisers](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers): Main hub for advertiser solutions, activation capabilities, and campaign performance offerings.
- [For Publishers](https://smartadserver.com/publishers): Main hub for publisher monetization, inventory management, and audience growth solutions.
- [For Retailers](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media): Overview of retail media solutions for commerce-driven advertising and monetization.
- [CTV](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/ctv): Connected TV advertising solutions for omnichannel reach and premium video environments.
- [Creative Solutions](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/creative-solutions): Interactive and enhanced ad experiences designed to improve engagement and outcomes.

## Advertiser Solutions
- [Advertisers](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers): Central landing page for advertiser products, workflows, and omnichannel media activation.
- [Campaign Curation](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/curation): Curated media buying solutions for improved control, quality, and performance.
- [AI-Driven Technology](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/curation/ai): Agentic and AI-powered curation capabilities for smarter campaign optimization.
- [CTV for Advertisers](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/ctv): Tools for planning and activating connected TV campaigns at scale.
- [Creative Ad Enhancements](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/creative-solutions): Rich media and creative optimization offerings for stronger ad effectiveness.
- [Media Services](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/media-services): Managed and strategic services supporting campaign execution and performance.
- [Sustainability-Focused Offerings](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/sustainability): Advertising solutions designed to support more sustainable media practices.

## Publisher Solutions
- [Publishers](https://smartadserver.com/publishers): Overview of publisher monetization products and supply-side platform capabilities.
- [Revenue Optimization](https://smartadserver.com/publishers/monetization-ssp): SSP and monetization tools for maximizing yield and inventory value.
- [Expand CTV Reach](https://smartadserver.com/publishers/ctv): Publisher solutions for monetizing connected TV inventory and expanding demand access.
- [Monetization SSP](https://smartadserver.com/publishers/monetization-ssp): Supply-side monetization workflows for premium digital inventory management.
- [CTV for Publishers](https://smartadserver.com/publishers/ctv): CTV monetization and audience extension solutions for media owners.

## Retail Media
- [Retail Media](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media): Omnichannel retail media platform for retailers and commerce media monetization.
- [Omnichannel Solutions](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media): Retail media capabilities spanning onsite, offsite, and in-store activation.
- [Ad Gallery](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media/billboard): Showcase of retail media ad formats and commerce-focused creative placements.
- [Retail Media for Advertisers](https://www.equativ.com/retail-media#advertisers): Retail media offering tailored to advertiser activation and commerce outcomes.
- [Kamino Retail](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media): Retail media technology supporting retailer monetization and advertiser access.

## AI and Specialized Products
- [Serverside.AI](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/curation/ai): AI-powered technology supporting campaign curation and optimization workflows.
- [Agentic AI](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/curation/ai): AI capabilities designed to automate and enhance media decision-making.
- [Sharethrough](https://smartadserver.com/): Native and omnichannel advertising brand referenced within Equativ’s platform portfolio.
- [Kamino Retail](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media): Commerce media solution for retailers building retail media networks.
- [AI-Driven Curation](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/curation/ai): Machine-assisted curation tools for improving efficiency and media quality.

## Creative and Performance
- [Creative Solutions](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/creative-solutions): Enhanced ad formats and creative technologies for better user engagement.
- [Campaign Curation](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/curation): Performance-focused media curation for advertisers seeking greater transparency.
- [Media Services](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/media-services): Expert support for campaign planning, activation, and optimization.
- [Sustainability](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/sustainability): Solutions aimed at reducing waste and improving responsible media delivery.
- [CTV Advertising](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers/ctv): Premium video advertising capabilities across connected TV environments.

## Solution Entry Points
- [Solutions for Advertisers](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers): Entry point to advertiser-focused products and activation capabilities.

- [Solutions for Retailers](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media): Entry point to retailer-focused commerce media and monetization tools.
- [Advertiser Platform](https://smartadserver.com/advertisers): Platform overview for brands and agencies running omnichannel campaigns.
- [Retail Media Platform](https://smartadserver.com/retail-media): Platform overview for building and scaling retail media programs.
